description: Review-pending source-backed draft profile based on PRESTUS Marsac-style density/sound-speed mapping and Mueller-style attenuation mapping. This is for model-build validation only and must not be used as a default pressure baseline.

source_backed_mapping.route: PRESTUS marsac density/sound-speed + PRESTUS mueller attenuation draft

density.formula: rho_water + (rho_bone - rho_water) * (clip(HU, HU_min, HU_max) - HU_min) / (HU_max - HU_min)

attenuation.formula: alpha_at_500khz = alpha_min + (alpha_max - alpha_min) * (1 - (clip(HU, HU_min, HU_max) - HU_min) / (HU_max - HU_min))^0.5; alpha_coeff = alpha_at_500khz / 0.5^alpha_power
attenuation.output_unit_assumption: dB/MHz/cm alpha0 for k-Wave-style alpha_coeff when alpha_power=1

notes: PRESTUS mueller route defines alpha_min/max at 500 kHz and converts to alpha0 using alpha_at_500khz / 0.5^alpha_power.
This metadata records intended semantics only; it does not validate pressure simulations.

evidence_source: PRESTUS source snapshot downloaded to data/source_code_refs/PRESTUS_source; see outputs/source_formula_extraction/key_formula_candidates.md
notes: This profile is for model-build-only validation. Do not use for pressure or thermal conclusions yet.
Density and sound speed follow PRESTUS Marsac-style source route.
Attenuation follows PRESTUS Mueller-style source route but remains high-risk because alpha units and k-Wave Python semantics require further audit.
Do not promote this profile unless model-build validation, unit audit, and user-reviewed evidence gates pass.
